_comment: Curated, presentation-only wallet identities. Highest precedence in build_wallet_names/build_wallet_avatars, above OpenSea usernames and verified ENS. Deliberately NOT scripts/labels.json: that file's `type` drives trace_core/trace_flows recursion, and these entries carry no claim about wallet class. `avatar_file` names a file in data/media/wallets/, served from the CDN under nftina/wallets/.
